### What Christ Did through Paul
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/what-christ-did-through-paul
Passage: Romans 15:17-19
Points:
- Paul attributed the authority and fruit of his ministry entirely to what Christ accomplished through him.
- Scripture condemns self-reliant arrogance, but it commends a God-honoring pride that exults only in the Lord.
- All service offered back to God is merely a return of the gifts and grace He previously provided.
- Paul recognized that his missionary labors from Jerusalem to Illyricum were completed through the Spirit's power.
- Believers are instruments in God's hands called to work faithfully while trusting Him alone for the results.
